row: Binomial phylo and spatial q2 with coefficient-specific SDs (native only)
evidence: Refutation attempt failed; the NOT_COVERED verdict stands. TSV row 2 reads point-fit-recovery, julia_old_pin ABSENT, julia_main ABSENT. I opened the cited tests and grepped the test dir. (1) test_binomial_animal_q2_sd.jl lines 31-36 use y ~ x + animal(1 + x | group) with sd(group, animal, coef(intercept)) ~ z0 and sd(group, animal, coef(x)) ~ z1 under Binomial(). Lines 159-161 and 188 repeat this for other links. It is a true q2 with coefficient-specific SDs, but the kernel is animal (A matrix), not phylo or spatial. (2) test_binomial_phylo_interaction_sd.jl uses phylo_interaction(1 | host & pollinator) with sd(pair, phylogenetic_interaction) ~ z (lines 78-79). That is intercept-only with no coef() and no slope. (3) test_binomial_phylo_interaction_slope_sd.jl uses phylo_interaction(0 + x | host & pollinator) with sd(pair, phylogenetic_interaction, coef(x)) ~ z (lines 65-66). That is slope-only (q1) with one SD formula. No passed test uses spatial with Binomial. The only other grep hit for phylo(1 + x | ...) in a passed test is test_phylo_slope_two_sd.jl. It is Gaussian (line 83), and its Poisson and NegBinomial2 hit at lines 166-177 is a refusal check, not a Binomial fit. test_triage_h_nonfinite.jl is not in the passed list and has no Binomial q2 phylo or spatial fit. The Binomial spatial files (test_binomial_spatial_sd_regression.jl, test_binomial_mesh_sd_regression.jl) are not in the passed list and are q1 only. No test in the Julia test dir has Binomial with phylo(1 + x | ...) or spatial(1 + x | ...).
gap: Both sub-shapes are missing a passing test. (a) Binomial phylo(1 + x | species) q2 with sd(species, phylogenetic, coef(intercept)) ~ ... and sd(species, phylogenetic, coef(x)) ~ ..., including the intercept-slope correlation. The only phylo q2 test that passed is Gaussian (test_phylo_slope_two_sd.jl), and its Poisson and NegBinomial2 cases are refusal checks. (b) Binomial spatial(1 + x | site) q2 with the same two coef-specific SD formulas. The animal q2 test is a different kernel. The phylo_interaction tests are q1 only (intercept-only or slope-only) and use a host x pollinator Kronecker kernel. The existing spatial Binomial tests are q1 and were not among the passed tests. If the row means native phylo-interaction q2, that is also uncovered, because no test fits intercept and slope together.

row: Gamma and NB2 same-group intercept + slope with `coef`-selected SDs (native only)

Gamma has no passing ordinary-mu SD test; test_gamma_sd_regression.jl is not in the passed list, and the passed Gamma SD tests are structured (animal/relmat/spatial/phylo) or sigma-side. The only Gamma intercept + slope with coef(intercept)/coef(x) SDs is the animal-kernel test (test_gamma_animal_intercept_slope_sd.jl:69-72), which is a different kernel and has no NB2 counterpart. test_nb2_animal_slope_sd_regression.jl is slope-only. Source (src/gamma.jl:497) states that correlated blocks are not implemented on the ordinary Gamma SD route.
gap: Missing Gamma ordinary (1 + x | g) / (1|g)+(0+x|g) with coef(intercept) and coef(x) SDs (no passing test). Even if the row meant the animal kernel, Gamma would be covered only for independent terms and NB2 animal intercept + slope would still be absent.
